nodes: Lava, ash and rocks settle in layers
Over thousands of years: a volcanic mountain
props.label: Volcanic mountains, p.47

scenes.narration: Magma escapes to the surface through an opening called a vent. Magma that reaches the surface is called lava. The lava, ash and rocks settle in layers, and over thousands of years they build a volcanic mountain.

nodes: Thin magma that flows easily: gentle slopes (Mauna Loa)
Thick, viscous lava: steep cone (Mt Fuji, Mt Vesuvius, Mt Kilimanjaro)
props.label: p.47

scenes.narration: If the magma is thin and flows easily, gently sloping mountains form, like Mauna Loa in Hawaii. If the lava is thick and viscous, the mountains are cone-shaped with steep sides, like Mount Fuji in Japan.

nodes: Continental: rises from the coast or plains (Africa)
Lava: lava spreads out of fissures (the Deccan)
props.label: Plateaus, p.48

scenes.narration: A plateau is a broad, flat, elevated area: a tableland. Its steep side is an escarpment. There are intermontane plateaus like Tibet, continental plateaus like those of Africa, and lava plateaus like the Deccan.

questions.prompt: Magma that reaches the surface of the Earth is called ____.

questions.explanation: The Deccan Plateau is a lava plateau (p.48).
